tiers.name: No Disconnect Propagation (Prefill Runs to Completion + Unclaimed Decode KV Leak)
tiers.note: Runs aborted 64K prefills to completion and pushes KV via RDMA to Decode; unclaimed KV blocks never free -> Decode OOM in 1 hour!

tiers.name: API Gateway Drops HTTP Stream Only (Missing Engine ZMQ Abort & Unolithic Prefill)
tiers.note: Closes client socket on timeout, but monolithic 64K prefill cannot preempt mid-flight and races with in-flight RDMA KV transfers!

tiers.name: Chunked Prefill Step-Boundary ZMQ Abort (No Distributed RDMA KV Lease TTL)
tiers.note: Aborts prefill within one 2,048-token chunk (~35ms), but cancellations during RDMA KV handshake still leak remote Decode buffers.

tiers.name: End-to-End Cancellation Propagation (Chunk-Boundary Abort + Prefix-Cache Salvage + Lease-TTL KV GC)
tiers.note: Polls client disconnect, aborts at 2K chunk boundary while keeping valid prefix blocks in APC, and auto-reclaims unclaimed RDMA KV via 5s lease TTL!
